name: Executive Chief of Staff Agent
Purpose: Creates concise executive briefings, surfaces decisions, and organizes issues requiring leadership attention.
When Deployed: Runs on executive dashboard load, before executive reviews, after material portfolio events, and on request.
Primary Inputs: Portfolio status, strategic priorities, risks, decisions, capacity, financial indicators, roadmap changes.
Primary Outputs: Executive brief, decision agenda, key questions, action summary, unresolved issue list.
Primary Users: CIO, VP of IT, executive leadership, IT Demand leadership.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human approval required before communicating commitments or changing priorities.

name: Portfolio Intelligence Agent
Purpose: Explains portfolio health across all IT work and identifies conflicts, exposure, and emerging delivery risk.
When Deployed: Continuously after Monday.com synchronization; on dashboard load; when portfolio scenarios run.
Primary Inputs: Project roadmaps, stage data, milestones, dependencies, risks, capacity, scope, priorities.
Primary Outputs: Portfolio health analysis, risk clusters, dependency conflicts, recommended portfolio actions.
Primary Users: CIO, IT leaders, Product Managers, IT Demand.
Approval / Control Boundary: Recommendations only; prioritization changes require IT Demand or authorized leadership approval.

name: Capacity Planning Agent
Purpose: Calculates and forecasts capacity from department to individual level and explains constraints.
When Deployed: After work, estimates, assignments, leave, sprint, or priority data changes.
Primary Inputs: Monday.com assignments, estimates, actuals, operational commitments, leave, sprint plans.
Primary Outputs: Utilization, remaining capacity, overages, constraint forecast, reassignment scenarios.
Primary Users: Function leaders, Product Managers, IT Demand, executives.
Approval / Control Boundary: Team and individual changes require function leader approval; portfolio effects may require Product Manager and IT Demand approval.

name: Atlas Portfolio Intelligence Agent
Purpose: Provides Atlas-specific portfolio intelligence, drill-down analysis, and reconciliation across team and project views.
When Deployed: Within Atlas portfolio views and when users ask portfolio questions.
Primary Inputs: Atlas data model, Monday.com records, cross-team contribution data, roadmap and capacity metrics.
Primary Outputs: Single-glance health, drill-down causes, reconciled totals, forecasted constraints.
Primary Users: CIO, executive sponsor, IT leadership, Product Managers.
Approval / Control Boundary: Read-only by default; actions route through normal approval workflows.

name: Atlas Executive Advisor Agent
Purpose: Translates Atlas findings into executive options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions.
When Deployed: When an executive opens an at-risk item, runs a scenario, or requests advice.
Primary Inputs: Portfolio intelligence, strategic goals, risks, capacity, financial and capitalization indicators.
Primary Outputs: Decision options, tradeoffs, recommendation, evidence, confidence.
Primary Users: CIO, executive sponsor, executive reviewers.
Approval / Control Boundary: Cannot approve its own recommendation or commit resources.

name: Intake Agent
Purpose: Reviews new requests for completeness, clarity, duplication, and routing readiness.
When Deployed: Immediately when an intake is created or materially edited.
Primary Inputs: Intake answers, supporting documents, historical requests, Monday.com projects, SharePoint records.
Primary Outputs: Intake summary, missing questions, duplicate matches, readiness score, suggested routing.
Primary Users: IT Demand, request facilitators, Product Managers.
Approval / Control Boundary: IT Demand confirms intake readiness and routing.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy, Automate, Integrate, Decommission, Hybrid

name: Build vs Buy Agent
Purpose: Recommends Build, Buy, Automate, Integrate, Decommission, Hybrid, route, defer, or decline.
When Deployed: After intake reaches minimum completeness and when scope materially changes.
Primary Inputs: Business problem, capabilities, cost, urgency, systems, vendors, risk, data, integration needs.
Primary Outputs: Classification recommendation, alternatives, rationale, risks, required functions, confidence.
Primary Users: IT Demand, Product Manager, business owner, technical leaders.
Approval / Control Boundary: IT Demand makes final classification; control-function hard stops cannot be overridden.

name: Business Case Agent
Purpose: Builds the value, cost, risk, benefit, and outcome rationale for approving work.
Deployment Mode: Required for Standard/Full; optional for Light
When Deployed: After classification and before project activation or major funding decisions.
Primary Inputs: Scope, expected outcomes, estimates, cost, capacity, risks, alternatives, strategic alignment.
Primary Outputs: Business case, benefit statement, cost range, assumptions, success measures, decision brief.
Primary Users: IT Demand, business owner, Finance, executive approvers.
Approval / Control Boundary: Business owner accepts outcomes; Finance and leadership approve funding where required.

name: Innovation Scout Agent
Purpose: Identifies emerging solutions, vendors, patterns, and reusable capabilities relevant to the request.
When Deployed: During early discovery or when classification confidence is low.
Primary Inputs: Problem statement, market category, existing architecture, approved technology standards.
Primary Outputs: Opportunity scan, solution patterns, potential vendors, risks, questions for evaluation.
Primary Users: IT Demand, Product Managers, Architecture, Procurement.
Approval / Control Boundary: Informational only; no purchase or technology approval authority.

name: Product Strategy Agent
Purpose: Converts business goals into product direction, outcomes, measures, and roadmap themes.
When Deployed: After classification, during discovery, and when scope or strategy changes.
Primary Inputs: Business case, stakeholder needs, strategic priorities, constraints, current capabilities.
Primary Outputs: Product vision, outcome map, success measures, strategic roadmap themes.
Primary Users: Product Manager, business owner, IT Demand.
Approval / Control Boundary: Product Manager owns product direction; business owner accepts outcome alignment.

name: Requirements Agent
Purpose: Extracts, structures, traces, and validates business and product requirements.
When Deployed: During discovery and requirements; reruns when approved scope changes.
Primary Inputs: Intake, interviews, notes, BRD, SOW, policies, workflows, existing system data.
Primary Outputs: Requirements, gaps, assumptions, traceability map, acceptance criteria candidates.
Primary Users: Product Manager, Business Analyst, UX, Engineering, QA, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Requirements must be reviewed and approved by designated human owners.

name: PRD Agent
Purpose: Creates and updates the Product Requirements Document from approved inputs.
Deployment Mode: Required where a PRD is needed
When Deployed: After requirements reach sufficient maturity and whenever approved scope changes.
Primary Inputs: Approved requirements, workflows, personas, constraints, acceptance criteria, roadmap.
Primary Outputs: Draft PRD, change summary, unresolved questions, linked evidence.
Primary Users: Product Manager, UX, Engineering, QA, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Product Manager approves the controlled PRD; AI cannot self-approve.

name: Feature Prioritization Agent
Purpose: Scores and sequences features by value, urgency, risk, dependency, effort, and capacity.
When Deployed: During MVP definition, roadmap changes, backlog refinement, and portfolio reprioritization.
Primary Inputs: Requirements, business value, estimates, dependencies, risk, capacity, user impact.
Primary Outputs: Priority proposal, MVP recommendation, tradeoff analysis, deferred scope.
Primary Users: Product Manager, business owner, IT Demand, function leaders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Product Manager approves product-level priority; IT Demand approves portfolio priority.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Automate, Integrate; selected Buy configurations

name: Personal Product Manager Agent
Purpose: Acts as a private planning assistant for a Product Manager, organizing decisions, follow-ups, risks, and next actions.
When Deployed: On demand and after meetings, roadmap events, or unresolved decisions.
Primary Inputs: Assigned projects, notes, tasks, decisions, risks, calendar items, communications.
Primary Outputs: Personal action plan, follow-up list, decision reminders, briefing notes.
Primary Users: Individual Product Managers.
Approval / Control Boundary: Cannot change shared records without normal confirmation and approval.

name: UX Research Agent
Purpose: Plans research, creates guides, organizes findings, and identifies user evidence gaps.
When Deployed: During Discovery and when user behavior or needs are uncertain.
Primary Inputs: Business problem, user groups, existing research, analytics, constraints.
Primary Outputs: Research plan, interview guide, sampling plan, synthesis framework, findings draft.
Primary Users: UX researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human researchers conduct/validate research and approve findings.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy, Automate, Integrate, Decommission where users are affected

name: Persona Agent
Purpose: Creates evidence-based persona drafts and updates them when new research changes understanding.
When Deployed: After sufficient research evidence exists.
Primary Inputs: Research findings, analytics, support themes, user roles, workflow evidence.
Primary Outputs: Persona drafts, needs, behaviors, pain points, goals, confidence notes.
Primary Users: UX, Product Manager, Training, Communications.
Approval / Control Boundary: Personas require human review and must identify assumptions.

name: Journey Mapping Agent
Purpose: Maps current and future user journeys, handoffs, pain points, and service dependencies.
When Deployed: During discovery, workflow redesign, and pre-release validation.
Primary Inputs: Research, process maps, requirements, support data, stakeholder interviews.
Primary Outputs: Current-state journey, future-state journey, gaps, opportunities, ownership map.
Primary Users: UX, Product Manager, process owners, function leaders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human review required before roadmap or scope commitments.

name: Prototype Review Agent
Purpose: Reviews prototypes for workflow completeness, usability, accessibility, consistency, and dead UI.
When Deployed: After prototype milestones and before stakeholder review or development handoff.
Primary Inputs: Prototype screens, flows, design system, requirements, acceptance criteria.
Primary Outputs: Heuristic findings, severity ratings, missing states, accessibility issues, remediation list.
Primary Users: UX, Product Manager, Engineering, QA, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: UX/Product Manager decides disposition; does not replace usability testing.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Automate, Integrate; configured Buy experiences

name: Design System Agent
Purpose: Checks design-system compliance and recommends reusable components and tokens.
When Deployed: During design creation, prototype review, and development handoff.
Primary Inputs: Design files, component library, tokens, accessibility standards.
Primary Outputs: Compliance report, component recommendations, exceptions, token mapping.
Primary Users: UX/UI designers, Engineering, Product Manager.
Approval / Control Boundary: Design-system owner approves exceptions and changes.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Automate, Integrate; selected Buy configurations

name: Faculty Experience Agent
Purpose: Evaluates workflows and communications from the faculty perspective.
When Deployed: When faculty are affected by scope, testing, rollout, or adoption.
Primary Inputs: Faculty research, workflows, policies, requirements, support themes.
Primary Outputs: Faculty impact analysis, usability risks, training and communication recommendations.
Primary Users: Product Manager, UX, faculty stakeholders, Training.
Approval / Control Boundary: Faculty representatives validate material findings.

name: Student Success Agent
Purpose: Assesses how proposed technology affects learner success, access, clarity, and completion.
When Deployed: When learners are affected by a project or release.
Primary Inputs: Learner research, analytics, requirements, support data, accessibility considerations.
Primary Outputs: Learner impact analysis, risk flags, success measures, experience recommendations.
Primary Users: Product Manager, UX, Student Success stakeholders, executives.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human stakeholders approve learner-impact decisions.

name: Collaboration Agent
Purpose: Supports distributed team or learner collaboration workflows and identifies coordination needs.
When Deployed: When scope requires real-time collaboration, shared artifacts, group submissions, or cross-team work.
Primary Inputs: Collaboration requirements, roles, permissions, workflows, tools, risks.
Primary Outputs: Collaboration model, participation rules, feature requirements, moderation/support needs.
Primary Users: Product Manager, UX, Engineering, QA, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human approval required for access, moderation, and policy decisions.

name: Solution Architecture Agent
Purpose: Creates solution options and identifies systems, interfaces, data, environments, dependencies, and technical risks.
When Deployed: After requirements are stable enough for technical design and when architecture changes.
Primary Inputs: Requirements, current architecture, standards, data classification, integrations, constraints.
Primary Outputs: Architecture options, recommended design, dependency map, risk register, decision record draft.
Primary Users: Architects, Engineering, Data, DevOps, InfoSec, Product Manager.
Approval / Control Boundary: Architecture and control functions approve technical decisions.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy implementation, Automate, Integrate, Decommission

name: Development Planning Agent
Purpose: Converts approved scope and architecture into epics, stories, tasks, estimates, sequencing, and sprint candidates.
When Deployed: Before development begins and during replanning.
Primary Inputs: PRD, requirements, architecture, dependencies, capacity, team standards.
Primary Outputs: Development plan, backlog proposal, estimates, sprint sequence, missing work.
Primary Users: Engineering leads, Product Manager, QA, DevOps.
Approval / Control Boundary: Engineering/function leaders approve estimates and assignments; PM approves roadmap impact.

name: Code Review Assistant Agent
Purpose: Assists reviewers by checking code changes against standards, requirements, security patterns, and test expectations.
When Deployed: During pull request review and before merge.
Primary Inputs: Code diff, standards, architecture decisions, requirements, tests.
Primary Outputs: Review findings, risk notes, suggested corrections, missing tests.
Primary Users: Developers, engineering leads, security reviewers.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human engineer approves merge; agent cannot independently merge production code.

name: Environment Agent
Purpose: Tracks environment needs, readiness, access, configuration, and promotion dependencies.
When Deployed: During technical design, DevOps preparation, testing, and release.
Primary Inputs: Environment inventory, configuration, access requests, deployment plans, dependencies.
Primary Outputs: Environment readiness status, missing access, configuration checklist, blockers.
Primary Users: DevOps, Engineering, QA, Product Manager.
Approval / Control Boundary: DevOps owns environment readiness and approvals.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy implementation, Automate, Integrate, Decommission

name: Release Readiness Agent
Purpose: Evaluates whether scope, testing, approvals, communications, training, support, rollback, and deployment conditions are complete.
When Deployed: Before go/no-go, after major release changes, and on demand.
Primary Inputs: PRD, QA/UAT results, defects, deployment plan, rollback plan, training, communications, approvals.
Primary Outputs: Readiness score, missing items, release risks, go/no-go recommendation.
Primary Users: Product Manager, QA, DevOps, Support, business owner, executives.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human release authority makes final go/no-go decision.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy, Automate, Integrate, Decommission cutovers

name: Test Planning Agent
Purpose: Creates a risk-based test strategy and test-case coverage from requirements and architecture.
When Deployed: After requirements and solution design are sufficiently stable.
Primary Inputs: Requirements, acceptance criteria, architecture, workflows, risks, integrations.
Primary Outputs: Test plan, test cases, coverage map, environment/data needs, entry/exit criteria.
Primary Users: QA, Product Manager, Engineering, business testers.
Approval / Control Boundary: QA owns test strategy and final approval.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy implementation, Automate, Integrate, Decommission validation

name: UAT Coordinator Agent
Purpose: Organizes business acceptance testing, participants, scenarios, evidence, defects, and sign-off.
When Deployed: Before and during UAT.
Primary Inputs: Approved acceptance criteria, workflows, test users, schedule, environment readiness.
Primary Outputs: UAT plan, assignments, scripts, issue log, status, sign-off package.
Primary Users: QA, Product Manager, business owner, stakeholders, faculty/staff testers.
Approval / Control Boundary: Business owner or delegated approver accepts business outcomes.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy, Automate, Integrate; selected Decommission transitions

name: Regression Agent
Purpose: Identifies existing workflows that may be affected and proposes regression coverage.
When Deployed: When code, configuration, integrations, vendor releases, or dependencies change.
Primary Inputs: Change set, architecture, existing tests, critical workflows, incident history.
Primary Outputs: Regression scope, impacted systems, prioritized tests, risk assessment.
Primary Users: QA, Engineering, DevOps, Product Manager.
Approval / Control Boundary: QA approves regression scope and results.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy vendor release, Automate, Integrate, Decommission

name: AI Governance Agent
Purpose: Evaluates AI use for transparency, human oversight, model risk, data use, and appropriate controls.
When Deployed: Whenever AI is part of the solution or an agent gains a new high-impact capability.
Primary Inputs: AI use case, model behavior, data sources, decisions, users, risks, controls.
Primary Outputs: AI governance assessment, required safeguards, approval conditions, monitoring plan.
Primary Users: AI governance, InfoSec, Legal, Data Governance, Product Manager.
Approval / Control Boundary: Designated control functions approve or block AI use.
Applicable Project Models: Build, Buy, Automate, Integrate involving AI

name: Data Governance Agent
Purpose: Assesses data classification, ownership, retention, access, quality, lineage, and permitted use.
Deployment Mode: Required when data is materially affected
When Deployed: When data is introduced, moved, transformed, retained, archived, or decommissioned.
Primary Inputs: Data inventory, flows, systems, owners, policies, integration maps, retention needs.
Primary Outputs: Governance requirements, data-owner actions, lineage gaps, retention/access conditions.
Primary Users: Data Governance, Data Engineering, Product Manager, system owners.
Approval / Control Boundary: Data Governance decisions are authoritative and may hardstop progress.

name: Procurement Agent
Purpose: Coordinates vendor evaluation, purchasing steps, pricing comparison, obligations, and procurement readiness.
When Deployed: For Buy projects and any work requiring a paid vendor, renewal, or external service.
Primary Inputs: Business case, vendor proposals, pricing, terms, requirements, approvals.
Primary Outputs: Vendor scorecard, procurement checklist, cost comparison, status, missing actions.
Primary Users: Procurement, IT Demand, Product Manager, Finance, Legal.
Approval / Control Boundary: Procurement and Finance approve purchase actions.

name: Contract Review Agent
Purpose: Extracts contract obligations, risks, dates, service terms, renewal terms, exit conditions, and negotiation questions.
When Deployed: When contracts, SOWs, order forms, renewals, or terminations are introduced.
Primary Inputs: Contract documents, SOWs, pricing, requirements, vendor commitments.
Primary Outputs: Obligation summary, risk flags, renewal calendar, negotiation points, comparison.
Primary Users: Legal, Procurement, Product Manager, Finance, system owner.
Approval / Control Boundary: Legal makes final legal determination; agent is not legal authority.

name: Communications Agent
Purpose: Drafts targeted event-driven stakeholder communications that explain what changed, why, impact, and next actions.
When Deployed: After material stage, scope, risk, approval, milestone, release, pause, or ownership events.
Primary Inputs: Event record, project context, affected users, decisions, roadmap impact.
Primary Outputs: Email drafts, announcements, executive notes, communication log entries.
Primary Users: Product Manager, Communications, IT Demand, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Critical or sensitive communications require Product Manager or designated reviewer approval.

name: Training Agent
Purpose: Creates role-based training plans, guides, FAQs, walkthrough scripts, and adoption support.
When Deployed: During implementation and before release; updates after material workflow changes.
Primary Inputs: Approved workflows, roles, screenshots, requirements, release plan, support model.
Primary Outputs: Training plan, quick guides, FAQs, video scripts, role-based curricula.
Primary Users: Training, Product Manager, UX, Support, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Content owners and business representatives review before release.

name: Product Analytics Agent
Purpose: Defines measures and analyzes adoption, workflow performance, outcomes, and post-launch behavior.
When Deployed: During planning for measurement and after release.
Primary Inputs: Success measures, product events, usage data, support data, baseline metrics.
Primary Outputs: Measurement plan, KPI definitions, dashboards, adoption insights, improvement recommendations.
Primary Users: Product Manager, Analytics, business owner, executives.
Approval / Control Boundary: Metric definitions and interpretations require human review.

name: Executive Reporting Agent
Purpose: Produces concise portfolio and project reports for executive audiences.
When Deployed: On scheduled reporting cycles, before executive meetings, and after critical events.
Primary Inputs: Roadmaps, stage, capacity, risk, decisions, financials, outcomes, data confidence.
Primary Outputs: Executive summary, scorecard, decisions required, trend narrative.
Primary Users: CIO, VP of IT, executive board, IT Demand.
Approval / Control Boundary: Report owner reviews externally distributed reports.

name: Knowledge Librarian Agent
Purpose: Organizes, links, tags, finds, and identifies the approved source of truth across SharePoint and project records.
When Deployed: When documents are created, uploaded, approved, superseded, or requested.
Primary Inputs: SharePoint files, metadata, project links, approvals, document types, version history.
Primary Outputs: Document map, source-of-truth designation, duplicate/conflict alerts, missing-artifact report.
Primary Users: All project users according to permissions.
Approval / Control Boundary: Document owners approve source-of-truth status and access.

name: Meeting Facilitator Agent
Purpose: Prepares agendas, captures decisions and actions, and links meeting outcomes to project records.
When Deployed: Before and after project meetings, gates, design reviews, and decision sessions.
Primary Inputs: Project context, open decisions, risks, prior notes, attendees, roadmap.
Primary Outputs: Agenda, decision log updates, action items, unresolved questions, follow-up draft.
Primary Users: Product Manager, IT Demand, function leaders, stakeholders.
Approval / Control Boundary: Human meeting owner validates notes and decisions before write-back.
